title: Jiuzhaigou in Winter
description: A first photographic collection: snow among lakes, forests, streams, and mountains, where winter reveals a quieter shade of blue.
coverAlt: Snow falling between a blue-green lake and a winter forest

photos.alt: Snow falling over a blue-green lake beside winter trees and a wooden walkway
photos.caption: Snow enters the lake and settles among the trees and boards.

photos.alt: A swift stream passing between rocks in a dark forest
photos.caption: The voice of water keeps winter from becoming wholly still.

photos.alt: Water plants and a pale shore visible beneath clear lake water
photos.caption: In the shallows, transparency slowly deepens into blue-green.

photos.alt: A moss-covered branch crossing the foreground of a conifer forest
photos.caption: Seen closely, the forest reveals a grain of its own.

photos.alt: Submerged rocks of varying depth beneath blue-green water
photos.caption: Stones beneath the surface divide the blue into many depths.

photos.alt: Bare branches crossing blue-green lake water and reeds
photos.caption: Between bare wood and water lies winter’s lightest colour.

photos.alt: Reeds extending into blue-green water with a dark forest beyond
photos.caption: Reeds, water, and forest divide the view into three quiet distances.

photos.alt: Stones beneath clear water beside a pebbled shore
photos.caption: The surface softens stone and slows the light.

photos.alt: A clear boundary between white ice and blue-green lake water
photos.caption: Between ice and water, a boundary changes almost too slowly to see.

photos.alt: Clear water running between snowy banks and rocks
photos.caption: Snow lowers every colour; the stream carries light back in.

photos.alt: Sunlight passing between tall trunks in a winter forest
photos.caption: Light descends between the trees and keeps one small clearing bright.

photos.alt: A winter stream descending over tiers of moss-covered rock
photos.caption: Even a small fall is enough to set the whole frame in motion.

photos.alt: Snow-covered mountain cliffs beneath a clouded sky
photos.caption: The scale of the mountain sends every sound far away.

photos.alt: A traditional roof beside snowy travertine pools in winter
photos.caption: Snow, shallow pools, and a roof lend winter a human outline.

photos.alt: A snow-covered mountain veiled by cloud at the end of a white valley
photos.caption: Partly hidden by cloud, the distant mountain looks more like memory.
